_note: RENCI's research groups as described on https://renci.org/research/groups/ (retrieved 2026-10-07). Used by the routing and custom workflow stages (orchestrator-worker and subgraphs read renci.md and let the model list the groups). search_terms are the fixed queries the custom workflow runs for each group.

groups.name: Analytics and Data Science
groups.focus: Partners with researchers across domains to advance their research by applying analytics: AI and machine learning, visual analytics, and semantic web and knowledge graph technologies.
projects: NCATS Biomedical Data Translator: knowledge-graph-based integration of biomedical datasets
ROBOKOP: biomedical question answering over knowledge graphs
HEAL Data Stewardship Group and HEAL Semantic Search
Dug Semantic Search for biomedical datasets
Imageomics Institute: machine learning on biological images
NC TraCS informatics
MM-ARIEL: multimodal machine learning for autoimmune disease diagnosis

groups.name: Data Management
groups.focus: Data planning, collection, standardization, documentation, storage, sharing and long-term preservation; develops and maintains iRODS, open-source policy-based data management software.
projects: iRODS: open-source, policy-based data management software
iRODS Consortium
Evryscope: petabyte-scale astronomical image data managed with iRODS
Lifetime Library: trusted storage for students and alumni
RESOLVE survey data
MESA: AI-driven discovery of publicly funded research data through curated metadata

groups.name: Earth Data Science
groups.focus: Advances fundamental science and informs decision-making on climate, weather, natural hazards and environmental health, with projects on coastal hazards, environmental health and geospatial systems.
projects: Multi-decadal coastal water level reanalysis with ADCIRC
ADCIRC storm surge and wind-wave applications, including probabilistic hurricane forecasting
Coastal Hazards, Economic Prosperity, and Resilience Hub (NSF)
Galapagos Science Center

groups.name: Networking Research and Infrastructure
groups.focus: Creates cyberinfrastructure for scientific research, drawing on expertise in networking, architectures, distributed systems and applications to enable secure collaboration and data management.
projects: FABRIC: national testbed for networking, cybersecurity, distributed computing and machine learning research
FABRIC Across Borders
CI Compass: cyberinfrastructure support for NSF Major Facilities
PegasusAI: AI-integrated workflow management
SWARM: resilient workflow execution across distributed resources
AW-SDX: software-defined exchange points
Chameleon Cloud testbed
AERPAW: advanced wireless and aerial research platform

groups.name: Software Architecture
groups.focus: Develops cloud computing data science platforms and environments, and scalable knowledge management methods such as full-text search augmented with knowledge graphs and machine learning.
projects: HeLx: cloud command center for data science communities
EduHeLx: browser-based teaching environment for data science
ORDR(D): secure environment for de-identified UNC Health data
Clinical Trial Management Dashboard
Cardiac Device Surveillance Registry
mindLAMP: digital phenotyping
AI Sandbox: shared GPU environment for AI/ML experiments
